newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA CHANGYU TO OFFER 80 MLN B SHARES END-AUGUST.
newsitem.headline: CHINA CHANGYU TO OFFER 80 MLN B SHARES END-AUGUST.

text.p: China's Yantai Changyu Pioneer Wine Co Ltd will launch an initial public offering of 80 million B shares around the end of August for Shenzhen listing, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.

Changyu plans to use the proceeds to boost its annual production capacity to 70,000 tonnes from 30,000, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin but gave no details.
State media have reported the company aimed to raise 300 million yuan from the issue.
Changyu would issue an additional eight million B shares if the offer was heavily oversubscribed, the spokesman said.
Changyu, a leading wine producer based in Yantai in the eastern province of Shandong, is among the 33 firms selected this year by the securities authorities for B share listing.
Changyu has named China Guotai Securities Co Ltd and Everbright Securities Co Ltd as the main domestic underwriters, the spokesman said.
ABN AMRO Hoare Govett Asia would act as the international coordinator, he said.
Before the B share offer, the company had 220 million outstanding shares, all of which are state shares, the official said.
